title: Travellers Following a Star
paragraphs: Far to the east, in a land beyond the desert, some wise people who studied the stars noticed a new one. They believed it meant a great king had been born. So they packed gifts and set out on a long journey with no certain map. We will meet them properly at Epiphany, on 6 January. But their journey starts here, because the old promise had always said that people from far-off nations would come to the light. Isaiah wrote: "Nations will come to your light" (WEB). The Christmas story is for everyone, near and far, shepherd and scholar, village and city.
wonder: I wonder what the travellers hoped to find at the end of the road?
prayer: God of all nations, welcome the stranger and the seeker, and bring all to your light. Amen.
alt: Distant travellers cross desert dunes beneath one bright star, its golden tail leading them on.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
